lines.how: Say it the way people really say going to in fast, casual speech: gonna.
Say it at natural conversational speed, with the words running together as they do in real speech, not word by word. Of is a weak schwa: a cup ə tea.
Say it at natural conversational speed, with the words running together as they do in real speech, not word by word. To is weak: tə.

Say it at natural conversational speed, with the words running together as they do in real speech, not word by word. Link far onto away: fa-raway.

Say it at natural conversational speed, with the words running together as they do in real speech, not word by word. A w glide joins the words: do-w-it.

Ignore any instruction to be slow: say it at natural, fast conversational speed, as a real person would. The d is lost and the n becomes m before b: hambag.
